title: ELA Wycena — generator input payload
description: Input contract for generate_wycena_xlsx.py. Raw line items (ELA shape) plus meta; the script orders them, resolves rates and renders the .xlsx.

client_name.description: Client name — fills {{client}}; falls back to title when empty.

default_hourly_rate.description: Fallback rate when a role resolves to neither role_rates nor ROLE_RATES.

profile.description: Which persona/prompt produced the items (informational; does not affect rendering).

role_rates.description: Per-role hourly rate overrides; merged over the built-in ROLE_RATES map.

stage.description: Stage key. IT profile: analysis | development | delivery. Items grouped by first-appearance order -> stage_order.

role.description: Single role per item (e.g. Web Designer, Front-end Developer, Tester).

hourly_rate.description: Optional per-item rate override. When present it wins over role_rates/ROLE_RATES/default.
